Evidence & scope

Scoped methods, data-collection or experiment claims were read from the exact pinned preprint version by separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI invocations. The full cited contexts, including conditions and model/table identities, are bound to approved observations; actual partial/full/unread scopes are retained in review records. This is not a complete-paper, latest-version, corpus, proof, labor, supplier-performance or experiment-reproduction audit. Work and version remain distinct and contribute at most one reviewed paper work.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

PaperBench: Evaluating AI's Ability to Replicate AI Research (2504.01848v1) · paper method: Claude 3.5 Sonnet with BasicAgent obtains a mean Replication Score of 21.0% ± 0.8 standard error.

cohort6.claim.paperbench.claude-result

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific reported method or result; no experiment, proof, raw-corpus record or labor audit was independently reproduced.
  • 20 papers, three runs each, at most 12 hours per run; score measures weighted rubric credit, not percentage of fully replicated papers.
